payload.text: (2026-10-25) CORRECTION FORWARD of e2f9287cc's message, which says AC-04.7 stays open until WP-04 Part A: it is wrong. AC-04.7 is test-backed, so the tool computes it from AT-04.7, and it read satisfied: yes the moment AT-04.7 went green. What AT-04.7 proves is the page reading no key the reader never sends, with recent present and empty; the strip showing finished requests from real slot records is proved only when WP-04 Part A lands and its arms fill recent. If AC-04.7 should wait for that, the fix is a second covering AT from Part A's arms, not hand-setting the criterion.
